description: This Java source file defines the class 'DittoMessageMapper', which implements message mapping logic for the Ditto protocol within a connectivity mapping framework. It handles converting between ExternalMessage objects and Adaptable objects, processing JSON payloads, and managing message headers.

classes.name: DittoMessageMapper
classes.description: A final class implementing message mapping for the Ditto protocol. Supports converting between ExternalMessage and Adaptable representations, with default options and context setup.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Converts an ExternalMessage to a list containing a ProtocolFactory Protocol Adaptable, extracting and processing JSON payloads and headers.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Converts an Adaptable to a list containing an ExternalMessage, serializing JSON payloads and assigning appropriate headers based on message content.

methods.name: getDefaultOptions
methods.description: Returns the default JSON options for the message mapper.

methods.name: extractPayloadAsString
methods.description: Extracts the payload string from an ExternalMessage, handling text and byte messages, throwing an exception if payload is missing or empty.

methods.name: determineCharset
methods.description: Determines the Charset for decoding byte payloads based on message headers.
